headline.zh:
改一处，
不必重算整张图。
headline.en:
Change one thing.
Not the whole graph.

sub.zh: 给已有代码图谱接上增量更新：追踪文件变化，解释影响范围，只重算受影响的节点。
sub.en: Add incremental updates to an existing code graph: track file changes, explain their reach, and re-derive affected nodes.

body.zh: 用内容哈希找到变化，沿依赖关系标记受影响节点。重算按拓扑顺序执行，成功的节点随即更新检查点。
body.en: Content hashes detect changes. Dependencies identify affected nodes. Re-derive in topological order and checkpoint each successful call.

title.en: Every dirty node has a reason.

body.zh: status --why 区分文件直接变化与依赖传播。顺着路径看，就知道一次修改为什么会影响远处的摘要。
body.en: status --why separates changed sources from propagated effects. Follow the path to see why an edit invalidates a downstream summary.

body.zh: 读取 graphify JSON、code-review-graph SQLite，或用 add / link 手动接入。状态存在独立 sidecar 中，无需另起一个图谱服务。
body.en: Read graphify JSON or code-review-graph SQLite, or wire nodes with add / link. State lives in a separate sidecar, with no graph server to operate.

title.zh: 改一个文件。看它更新到哪里。
title.en: Edit one file. See what updates.

note.zh: 这个示例创建 8 个源文件，修改 auth.py，再运行真实 CLI。4 个节点重算，4 个保持不变；你可以在本地复现整个过程。
note.en: This example creates eight source files, edits auth.py, then runs the real CLI. Four nodes are re-derived and four stay untouched. Reproduce the entire run locally.

body.zh: 所有源文件与记录一致，当前没有节点需要重算。
body.en: All source files match their checkpoints. No node needs re-derivation.

body.zh: 修改 auth.py 后，auth、session、views、api 需要重算。其余 4 个节点不受影响。
body.en: After editing auth.py, auth, session, views and api need re-derivation. The other 4 nodes are unaffected.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 4 dirty of 8
  changed sources: 1
  direct hits: 1 | propagated: 3
  [propagated] api  via auth -> session -> views -> api
  [direct]    auth  <- source: auth.py
  [propagated] session  via auth -> session
  [propagated] views  via auth -> session -> views

body.zh: 按依赖顺序重算这 4 个节点，成功后更新状态。
body.en: Re-derive the 4 nodes in dependency order and checkpoint successful calls.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 4 dirty of 8
re-derived 4 nodes (of 8)
  + auth
  + session
  + views
  + api

body.zh: 没有新修改，再运行时不会重复重算。
body.en: With no further edit, the next pass re-derives zero nodes.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 0 dirty of 8
re-derived 0 nodes (of 8)

body.zh: Python 3.12+。示例自带完整输入，自动创建并清理临时目录，不需要 API Key。
body.en: Python 3.12+. The example includes its inputs, creates and cleans up a temporary directory, and needs no API key.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/dirtygraph.git
cd dirtygraph
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 当前按文件内容判断变化，每个节点关联一个源文件；依赖关系由输入图提供。
limitations.en: Changes are detected at file level, with one source file per node. The input graph supplies dependencies.

limitations.zh: CLI 保存检查点，不会把新摘要写回原图。需要持久化派生结果时，在自定义 adapter 中接入你的存储。
limitations.en: The CLI saves checkpoints, not new summaries in your original graph. Persist derived results through a custom adapter connected to your storage.

limitations.zh: 8 文件 Demo 用于解释行为，不代表大仓库性能；实际重算范围取决于你的依赖关系。
limitations.en: The eight-file demo illustrates behavior, not large-repository performance. Your dependency structure determines the affected set.

title.zh:
代码一直在变。
图谱也该跟得上。
title.en:
Your code keeps moving.
Your graph should keep up.

body.zh: 你改了 auth.py，认证摘要需要更新，依赖它的会话和 API 说明也可能过时。把整张图重新生成当然能解决问题，但重复工作会越来越多。DirtyGraph 把文件、派生节点和依赖关系连起来，让已有图谱知道下一次该重算哪里。
body.en: You edit auth.py. Its summary is stale, and the session and API descriptions that depend on it may be stale too. Regenerating the whole graph works, but repeats more work as the graph grows. DirtyGraph connects files, derived nodes and dependencies so your existing graph knows what to re-derive next.

body.zh: auth 的变化传到 session、views 和 api；invoice、billing、search、logger 保持原样。重算完成后，没有新修改，下一轮就是零次更新。
body.en: The auth change reaches session, views and api. Invoice, billing, search and logger stay untouched. Once re-derivation completes, a pass with no further edit performs zero updates.

alt.zh: 8 文件示例：4 个受影响节点与 4 个无关节点
alt.en: Eight-file example: four affected nodes and four untouched nodes

title.zh: 把影响范围算清，再动手。
title.en: Find the affected set. Then run.

body.zh: BLAKE3 比对源文件内容，依赖图求出脏闭包，引擎按拓扑顺序调用 adapter。Store 保存哈希和脏位；应用通过 adapter 将新的派生内容存回自己的系统。
body.en: BLAKE3 compares source contents. The dependency graph finds the dirty closure, and the engine calls adapters in topological order. Store keeps hashes and dirty bits; your adapter persists new derived content into your application.

alt.zh: 输入、变化检测、依赖传播、adapter 与 sidecar 的关系
alt.en: Inputs, change detection, propagation, adapters and sidecar checkpoints

title.zh: 已有的工具，都有接入位置。
title.en: A place in your existing stack.

body.zh: 图谱构建器负责把代码变成图，DirtyGraph 负责跟踪这张图里的派生依赖。本地摘要开箱即用，需要模型重算时，再接入 OpenAI 兼容端点或自定义 Python adapter。
body.en: Your graph builder turns code into a graph. DirtyGraph tracks derived dependencies within it. Local summaries work out of the box; use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or a custom Python adapter when you need model-based re-derivation.

alt.zh: 支持的 JSON、SQLite、手动输入与三类 adapter 通路
alt.en: Supported JSON, SQLite and manual inputs with local, model and custom adapter paths

body.zh: 在项目目录中运行 init。JSON 中的节点需要 source_file 等源路径，关系来自 links 或 edges；SQLite 使用 nodes / edges 表。CALLS、IMPORTS 等关系会转成“依赖 → 使用者”的传播方向。
body.en: Run init from your project directory. JSON nodes need a source path such as source_file and relationships under links or edges; SQLite uses nodes / edges tables. Relations such as CALLS and IMPORTS are oriented from dependency to dependent.

details.code:
dirtygraph init ./graph.json
# Or import a code-review-graph store:
dirtygraph init ./.code-review-graph/

title.zh: 从一次检查，到持续更新
title.en: From a single check to continuous updates

body.zh: status --why 解释脏因；touch 只检查指定文件；watch --rederive 在文件事件后触发重算。reset 会接受当前文件状态并清除脏位，适合主动重建检查点。
body.en: status --why explains dirty causes; touch checks a single file; watch --rederive re-derives after file events. reset accepts current file contents and clears dirty bits when you intentionally want a new checkpoint.

details.code:
dirtygraph status --why
dirtygraph touch auth.py
dirtygraph watch --root . --rederive --adapter codegraph

body.zh: codegraph 默认生成确定性的本地摘要。设置 DIRTYGRAPH_LLM=1 和 API Key 后可走 OpenAI 兼容端点；默认配置为 DeepSeek，也可换成 Qwen 对应端点和模型。模型调用失败时回退到本地摘要。
body.en: codegraph produces deterministic local summaries by default. Set DIRTYGRAPH_LLM=1 and an API key to use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. DeepSeek is the default; configure the endpoint and model for Qwen. Failed model calls fall back to local summaries.

details.code:
export DIRTYGRAPH_LLM=1
export DIRTYGRAPH_LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/v1
export DIRTYGRAPH_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat
# Set DIRTYGRAPH_LLM_API_KEY in your environment.
dirtygraph rederive --adapter codegraph

title.zh: 图谱构建与增量维护，各做哪一段

body.zh: 从代码抽取实体、推断关系和提供图查询，由原有图谱工具负责。DirtyGraph 补上文件级变更检测、依赖传播、脏因解释和 adapter 调度。它适合已有图结构和派生任务的工作流，不提供 AST 解析器或图查询服务。
body.en: Entity extraction, relationship inference and graph queries belong to your graph tooling. DirtyGraph adds file-level detection, dependency propagation, dirty-cause explanations and adapter scheduling. It fits workflows with an existing graph and derivation tasks; it does not provide an AST parser or graph query service.

headline.zh:
让下一次更新，
只发生在该发生的地方。
headline.en:
Let your next update
follow the change.
